title: ¹³C NMR spectrum of propan-1-ol
caption: Each carbon environment gives one line. Propan-1-ol has three different carbons, so three lines; the one bonded to oxygen is furthest downfield (64 ppm). Propan-2-ol, by symmetry, would give only two.
alt: ¹³C spectrum with lines at about 10, 26 and 64 ppm, and the structure of propan-1-ol.
